settings.heading: Open your account
settings.text: Use the same sign-in method you used when placing your order.

settings.heading: Choose the order
settings.text: Open the purchase you want to review for its latest available details.

settings.heading: Follow the update
settings.text: If tracking is available, use the carrier link shown with the order for delivery progress.

settings.heading: Tracking taking a pause?
settings.text: Carrier scans can take time to appear after dispatch. Check again later or contact support if the expected delivery window has passed.

settings.heading: Checked out another way?
settings.text: Review the order confirmation sent after checkout. If you still cannot locate the order, our support team can help.
